configDefinition.name: sync_group
configDefinition.description: Group identifier — screens sharing the same group play the playlist in sync.

configDefinition.name: sync_server
configDefinition.description: URI of the synchronization server. Leave empty to use the signageOS default server.

configDefinition.name: sync_engine
configDefinition.description: Sync engine: "sync-server" (default) or "p2p-local" for LAN-only. All screens in a group must match.

configDefinition.name: items
configDefinition.description: JSON array of media to play in sync: [{type:"video"|"image", uid, uri, duration?}]. duration (ms) applies to images; videos play to their end. Falls back to a demo playlist when empty.

configDefinition.name: wait_timeout_ms
configDefinition.description: Barrier wait timeout in milliseconds; on timeout the loop retries instead of stalling (default 15000).
